frontmatter.title: Deterministic AI vs Autonomous Agents: Choosing the Right Level of Intelligence
frontmatter.subheading: Why not every problem needs an AI agent that thinks for itself
frontmatter.excerpt: Not all AI systems need autonomy. Learn the practical differences between deterministic AI workflows and non-deterministic AI agents, with real-world examples to help you choose the right approach.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
